analyzed_vuln.description: In the existing-ID branch, `ret->attr = attr` is incorrectly conditional on `ret->attr != NULL`. When an ID table entry was created in streaming/reader mode, `ret->attr` is NULL. A later non-streaming copy of that ID sets each copied attribute's `attr->id` to the shared `xmlID` and marks it as an ID, but never makes the `xmlID` point back to an attribute or clears the prior copied attribute. Multiple attributes can therefore retain the same `xmlID *`. If copying later fails, partial-tree cleanup frees the shared ID through the first attribute; `xmlRemoveID` then dereferences the second attribute's dangling `attr->id`, causing the heap-use-after-free at valid.c:2523.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Use the XML reader with entity substitution and a DTD-declared ID attribute. The entity replacement tree must contain repeated attributes with the same ID value (the PoC has two `<dest id='foo'>` elements), so the reader's streaming ID entry has `ret->attr == NULL` and subsequent `xmlDocCopyNode` operations attach that same ID object to multiple copied attributes. A later copy failure must invoke partial-tree cleanup; in this PoC the fuzz harness's allocation limit causes `xmlStaticCopyNode` to fail while copying later entity content. Cleanup calls `xmlRemoveID` for both duplicate attributes: the first frees the hash entry/xmlID, and the second reads the freed object.

args: Analyze the ownership/invariant semantics of xmlAddIDSafe in libxml2/valid.c, especially its existing-ID branch, and all non-streaming callers in libxml2/tree.c. Is the correct root fix to replace an existing xmlID's attr pointer whenever a non-streaming attr is supplied and clear the previous attribute's ID metadata? Explain what should happen for repeated duplicate IDs and streaming-created entries.

The reported ASan crash is a heap-use-after-free in xmlRemoveID at libxml2/valid.c:2528 during partial cleanup in xmlStaticCopyNode. An XML reader streaming entry has xmlID->attr NULL. Entity replacement content has two attributes with duplicate ID value. Later xmlDocCopyNode calls xmlAddIDSafe in non-streaming mode for each copied attr. Existing code reportedly only performs ret->attr = attr inside if (ret->attr != NULL), so when initially NULL it leaves both copied attrs pointing via attr->id to the same xmlID while the xmlID points to none. Cleanup of the first removes/frees the xmlID; cleanup of the second dereferences dangling attr->id. I need confirm intended duplicate-ID behavior and minimal safe patch.
